sources.method: Read the retained source review and exact XML response; counted all natural=coastline ways, closed component rings and open chains in the bounded response. Compared the proposed location source footprint with the single 10.993637 km² main-island ring. Detached rings have no name tags in the OSM ways used by this check; no nearest-point assignment or political boundary inference was made. This finite bbox is not a region-complete land census.

subject_assessments.name: Fugloy
subject_assessments.role: One location for the named main island of Fugloy at the source’s comparison floor. Do not split its 14-way coastline ring into one location per source way or village. This review makes no determination that all 34 detached rings are part of this named territorial subject.

accounting.administrative_remainder: No named remainder is identified; exact outer boundary and any outlying islet assignment cannot be tested without a municipal boundary source.

subject_assessments.assessment: The retained snapshot supports one contiguous named island ring made from 14 coastline ways, about 10.994 km² in the source review. The municipality itself names one remote island municipality and two villages. This supports one island location and argues against splitting settlements or coastline segments into locations. The source profile’s “whole-island dry-land source” is a role hint, not a certified complete coastline. A finite API bbox also returns 34 detached, unlabelled closed rings totaling about 0.01435 km² and two open chains; they may be skerries or other neighboring land, but their association, exposure threshold and municipal assignment are not independently sourced. Treat them as explicit coverage gaps, not as automatically included or as new locations. No added or clipped geometry is proposed.
subject_assessments.settlement_assessment: The municipality explicitly names Kirkja and Hattarvík as its two villages. Its page’s “today” population figures are undated and excluded from present-day counts. The OSM coastline ways describe physical shorelines, not settlements. No evidence here supports settlement exclusion through time; historical habitation is outside scope.
subject_assessments.administrative_role: The named local government supplies a plausible one-island municipality purpose for the province tier. The retained province has one child location and is marked as a coextensive exception. No official boundary polygon was located in the inspected municipal material, so exact coextensivity of its legal territory with the main island-only footprint (including rocks and islets) is insufficiently evidenced. Retain this as a sourced proposal subject to later boundary data; do not treat one-child counts as proof.

chain.name: Fugloyar municipality
chain.role: Administrative island-municipality group supported by the municipality website; exact legal boundary and offshore-islet relation unverified.

chain.name: Føroyar
chain.role: WGSRPD/TDWG geographic botanical area for the Faroe archipelago; this packet owns only Fugloy. Full area has a second member, FRO-1443/Eysturoyar, whose source-to-geographic-role fit and inclusion across the archipelago require regional integration review.

chain.name: Nordic Europe
chain.role: Approved fixed macro reporting group for Nordic and North Atlantic/Arctic islands; this packet supplies no evidence to alter its frozen envelope.

chain.name: Northern Europe
chain.role: Retain published macro parent; no source supports parent change.

chain.name: Europe
chain.role: Retain published macro parent; Faroe routing is geographic/archipelago association, not Danish or other political ownership.

parent_chain_assessment.completeness: All five declared ancestors and the one assigned location were checked against v5 pins. The area is only partially owned (1 of 2 locations); no approval of its sibling or the Nordic Europe branch is implied.

subject_assessments.neighbor_context: No inter-region inconsistency is evidenced in this one-location review. The retained source query includes many additional islands/islets and two incomplete shoreline chains in the wider bbox, but names and regional membership for these fragments are not inferred. The area sibling FRO-1443/Eysturoyar has a broad source shape that appears to encompass much of the archipelago despite its name; this is an intra-region source/role question for the existing Nordic Europe review (#332), not authorization to move or relabel any shared unit.
subject_assessments.recommended_treatment: Provisional retain one named Fugloy location and the one-island municipality province as sourced representations; do not change geometry or shared parents. Keep the 34 detached rings, two open chains and exact province coextensivity unresolved until an official higher-resolution shoreline/islet and municipal-boundary source or matching independent hydrographic dataset is obtained.

neighboring_scope.sibling_source: Natural Earth ADM1 fallback, undated, public domain
neighboring_scope.interpretation: These source metadata overlap values do not establish coastline accuracy or prove each location’s legal/physical extent. Request that issue #332 account for the two full area members together and the relevant outlying islets; do not alter this shared area or neighboring province in this packet.

political_and_historical_separation.owner_assignment: No owner inferred from macro membership or Danish polity metadata. Municipal administrative scope is evidence of local-government role only.

unresolved_findings: The 34 unlabelled detached OSM closed rings (0.014353 km² combined) and two open chains have no verified physical association to Fugloy or its legal municipality; source completeness and tidal exposure are not established.
The official municipal pages inspected do not provide a dated legal boundary polygon; exact province-location coextensivity, especially offshore islets, remains insufficiently evidenced.
OSM source edit timestamps are not a shoreline observation date; no independent national hydrographic coastline/datum dataset was reconciled to the 2026-10-02 map response.
The second Føroyar area member FRO-1443/Eysturoyar has an unresolved broad source-to-parent fit; coordinate joint review of the full partial area under Nordic Europe issue #332.
Regional interior review remains open; this packet does not certify the area, region, grid, regional envelope or location-attribute import readiness.

bounded_follow_up_recommendation.request: At Nordic Europe area review, assess Føroyar as one complete two-location grouping, source and bound the Eysturoyar feature against all Faroe islands, and obtain official municipal/islet coastline data to resolve Fugloy’s 34 detached rings and two open chains. Preserve both existing IDs and the release-5 envelope; any shared-parent or cross-region change requires a coordinated neighboring-scope task.

decision: Insufficient evidence for a conclusive whole-municipality shoreline/islet footprint and for the detached rings’ subject association. Current sourced one-location named main-island representation and administrative purpose are plausible and provisionally retained; no geographic correction or ownership conclusion. Review packet completion is not regional approval.
